crossRefs.note: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. You split the earth with rivers.

translations.web: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
translations.bsb: He hews out channels in the rocks, and his eyes spot every treasure.
translations.kjv: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
translations.asv: He cutteth out channels among the rocks; And his eye seeth every precious thing.
